## Hook
Five GTA 6 launch facts, confirmed by Rockstar.
Number one is the one everyone asks about.

## 5. No disc
[claim] The box has no disc.
[evidence] Rockstar says it's a download code only. [S3]

## 4. Pre-load
[claim] You can pre-load it now.
[evidence] Rockstar's Newswire says pre-loading opened on November tenth. [S5]

## 3. Price
[claim] Standard costs seventy-nine ninety-nine.
[evidence] That's the US price on Rockstar's own store. Ultimate costs more. [S3]

## 2. Bonus
[claim] There's a free bonus pack.
[evidence] Order before November twentieth to get the Vintage Vice City Pack. [S3]

## 1. The date
[claim] And it's out Thursday, November nineteenth.
[evidence] Rockstar's site lists the date, for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. [S1]
